title: Normalize hex colors
description: Implement normalize_hex_color(text). Accept '#RGB', '#RRGGBB' or '#RRGGBBAA' (the leading '#' is required; hex digits in either case). Return the canonical lowercase '#rrggbbaa'-free form: 3-digit input expands each digit ('#abc' -> '#aabbcc'), 6-digit stays 6-digit, and 8-digit input whose alpha is 'ff' drops the alpha, otherwise keeps it. Surrounding whitespace is allowed and stripped. Raise ValueError for any other length, missing '#', or non-hex characters.
invariants: Alpha 'ff' (any case) is dropped; other alpha is kept.
